name: New Sale Flow — select customer, browse products, add to cart, checkout

planSteps.description: Enter phone number 923001234567 and click Send Code
Click 'New Sale' quick action on the dashboard
The Select Customer page loads showing search bar, recent customers list with name, phone, and outstanding balance, and an 'Add New Customer' button
Click on a customer from the list
The Browse Products page loads showing customer name strip, search bar, category filters, product list with name, company, category, stock status, and a floating Scan button
The Variant Selector page loads showing product image, name, company, stock summary, variant options with prices and availability, quantity counter, and 'Add to Cart' button

The Cart page loads showing customer credit info, cart items with quantity controls, payment type selection (Full Payment / Partial Credit), payment method (Cash / Bank Transfer), summary with subtotal/paid/total, and 'Complete Sale' button
